short_explanation: Treatment: randomized treatment assignment with cleaned-data arms: Ketamine; Midazolam; Saline. Publication-designated control/reference: Saline.
Primary outcome: Change from pre-intervention to post-intervention in mean respiratory rate variability metric (MRR).
Primary outcome: Mean respiratory rate variability metric (MRR), measured immediately after the intervention.
Secondary outcome: Change from pre-intervention to post-intervention in ventilatory rate variability metric (VRR).
Secondary outcome: Ventilatory rate variability metric (VRR), measured immediately after the intervention.
Secondary outcome: Change from pre-intervention to post-intervention in tidal-volume variability metric (VTV).
Secondary outcome: Tidal-volume variability metric (VTV), measured immediately after the intervention.
